purpose: Business control plane for turning product experiments into measurable revenue outcomes

funnel.meaning: A potential customer reaches the product.
The customer reaches first meaningful value.
The customer starts a monetizable trial or workflow.
The customer completes a paid transaction.
The customer returns and continues receiving value.

experimentRule: Every business experiment must name a target metric, expected direction, observation window, and decision rule.
guardrail: No business metric is reported as observed until a real data source is connected.
